spans.s:
उत्स उत्स, अस्, m. (fr. 2 उद्), Ved. a spring,
a fountain (metaphorically applied to the clouds).
—उत्स-धि, इस्, m., Ved. the receptacle of a spring, a
well.

उत्सक्थ उत्-सक्थ, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. opening
the thighs.

उत्सङ्ग उत्-सङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सञ्ज् with
उद्), embrace, association, union; slope, side; the
haunch or part above the hip; the lap; the acclivity
or edge of a hill; the roof of a house; the bottom
or deep part of an ulcer; a high number = 100
Vivāhas.
उत्-सङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, associated, combined, joined.

उत्-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, associating or combining with,
an associate, a partner; deep-seated, as an ulcer; (ई),
m. an ulcer, a deep sore; (इनी), f. pimples on the
inner edge of the eyelids.
उत्-सञ्जन, अम्, n. leading upwards.

उत्सद् उत्-सद् (उद्-स्˚), cl. 1. P. -सीदति, -सत्-
तुम्, to sink, settle down, fall into ruin or decay; to
leave off; to rise up: Caus. P. -सादयति, -यितुम्,
to destroy, overturn.

उत्-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, decayed, in ruins; destroyed,
overturned; disused, fallen into disuse; risen, in-
creased.
—उत्सन्न-धर्म, अस्, or उत्सन्न-यज्ञ,
अस्, m. an interrupted or suspended sacrifice.

उत्-साद, अस्, m., Ved. a particular part of the
sacrificial animal.
उत्-सादक, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, overturning.

उत्-सादन, अम्, n. destroying, overturning; sus-
pending, interrupting, omitting; cleaning the person
with perfumes, rubbing or chafing the limbs; healing
a sore, causing it to fill up; going up, ascending,
rising; raising, elevating; ploughing a field twice or
thoroughly.

उत्-सादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed; to be
effected; to be gone up or ascended; (अम्), n. any
application to a sore producing granulations.

उत्-सादितव्य or उत्-साद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be de-
stroyed.
उत्सर, उत्सारक, &c. See under उत्-सृ.

उत्-सर, अस्, m. a species of the Ati-śakvarī metre,
consisting of four verses of fifteen syllables each.
उत्सर्ग उत्-सर्ग. See under उत्-सृज्.

उत्-सर्ग, अस्, m. pouring out, pouring forth, emis-
sion, dejection, excretion, voiding by stool &c.;
laying aside, abandoning, resigning, quitting, retiring
from, suspending; loosening, delivering; oblation,
libation; presentation of anything promised to a
god or Brāhman with suitable ceremonies; giving,
donation; a particular ceremony on suspending a
Vedic lecture; (in gram.) any general precept or
rule (opposed to अपवाद, special rule or exception,
and so called because only abolished in express cases
by a substitute).
—उत्सर्ग-तस्, ind. generally, i. e.
without any special limitation.

उत्सव उत्सव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. सु with उद्?),
enterprise, beginning; a festival, a jubilee; joy, glad-
ness; merry-making; height, elevation, insolence;
passion, wrath; wish; rising of a wish; a section of a
book.
—उत्सव-सङ्केत, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

उत्सह् उत्-सह् (उद्-स्˚), cl. 1. A. -सहते,
-सहितुम् or -सोढुम्, to be able, to be adequate,
to have power (with inf., or with dat. of an abstract
noun); to act with courage or energy: Caus. -साह-
यति, -यितुम्, to animate, encourage, excite; Desid.
of the Caus. -सिसाहयिषति, to wish to excite.

उत्-साह, अस्, m. power, strength, strength of will,
resolution; effort, perseverance, strenuous and con-
tinued exertion, energy; firmness, fortitude; hap-
piness; a thread.
—उत्साह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, active,
energetic, persevering.
—उत्साह-वर्धन, अस्, m. the
heroic रस or feeling; (अम्), n. increase of energy,
heroism.
—उत्साह-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, active,
persevering.
उत्-साहन, अम्, n. effort, perseverance.
उत्साहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, active, persevering.

उत्सिच् उत्-सिच् (उद्-स्˚), cl. 6. P. A. -सिञ्चति,
-ते, -सेक्तुम्, to sprinkle, pour, to spread; to make
proud: Pass. -सिच्यते, to spout or foam up or over;
to be puffed up; to overflow, increase.

उत्-सिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled; flooded, abun-
dantly furnished; elevated, raised, haughty, proud,
rude; enlarged, increased; disordered, disturbed in
mind &c.

उत्-सिच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, foaming or spouting
up, showering; increasing, overflowing, growing.

उत्-सेक, अस्, m. sprinkling, pouring; foaming up-
wards, spouting out or over, showering; overflow,
increase, enlargement; haughtiness, pride.

उत्सेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, overflowing; proud, haughty,
puffed up.

उत्-सेचन, अम्, n. the act of showering or spout-
ing upwards, boiling or foaming over.

उत्सुक उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. उद् and सुक;
the latter does not exist separately, but may be derived
from the particle सु, as अनुक fr. अनु, अभिक
fr. अभि; cf. also उत्क), restless, uneasy, unquiet,
anxious; anxiously desirous, zealously active, striving
[]
or making exertions for any object (e. g. जयोत्सुक,
anxiously striving for victory); eager for, fond of, at-
tached to; regretting, repining, missing, sorrowing
for; (अस्), m. (?) longing for.
—उत्सुक-ता, f. or
उत्सुक-त्व, अम्, n. restlessness, uneasiness, unquiet-
ness, zeal; attachment, affection; sorrow, regret.

उत्सुकाय, nom. A. उत्सुकायते, to become un-
quiet &c.

उत्सूत्र उत्-सूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unstrung; irre-
gular, out of rule, loose, detached.

उत्सूर उत्-सूर, अस्, m. evening, twilight
(when the sun sets).
उत्सूर्य. See under ओत्सूर्यम्.

उत्सृ उत्-सृ (उद्-सृ), Caus. P. -सारयति,
-यितुम्, to expel, turn out, drive away.

उत्-सर्या, f. a cow when grown up and fit to take
the bull.

उत्-सारक, अस्, m. one who drives away the mob
from a person of rank, a policeman; a guard, a
guardian.

उत्-सारण, अम्, n. moving, causing to move, re-
moving, keeping at a distance, driving out of the
way; assisting any one to step out (of a palanquin
&c.); reception of a guest.

उत्सृज् उत्-सृज् (उद्-स्˚), cl. 6. P. -सृजति,
-स्रष्टुम्, to pour out, emit, send forth; to let
loose; to cast forth or away; to lay aside, quit, leave,
abandon, avoid, eschew; to abolish (a rule &c.).

उत्सर्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, leaving out or off; omitting,
abandoning, quitting.

उत्-सर्जन, अम्, n. letting loose, abandoning,
leaving, &c.; gift, donation, oblation; suspending (a
lecture in the Veda), a ceremony connected with it.
उत्-सिसृक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to create.
उत्-सृज्य, ind. having abandoned, having quitted.

उत्-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned; given
up, given, presented; poured forth, cast into or upon.
—उत्सृष्ट-पशु, उस्, m. a bull set at liberty upon
particular occasions, as on a marriage &c., and allowed
to go about at will.
—उत्सृष्ट-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one
who has let fall, who has shed (a tear &c.).
उत्-सृष्टि, इस्, f. abandonment, letting go, emission.

उत्स्रष्टु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to let go or
put down.

उत्सृप् उत्-सृप् (उद्-स्˚), cl. 1. P. -सर्पति,
-सर्प्तुम् or -स्रप्तुम्, to go, glide or soar upwards,
to spread out.

उत्-सर्प, अस्, m. going or gliding upwards; swell-
ing, heaving.

उत्-सर्पण, अम्, n. gliding upwards; swelling,
heaving.

उत्-सर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, gliding or going upwards;
heaving, heaved, undulating.

उत्-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, moving or gliding upwards;
rising; soaring; (इणी), f. a Jaina division of time, a
long period described as ten crores of crores of oceans
of years; this period alternates with one of similar
duration. See अव-सर्पिणी.

उत्सेध उत्-सेध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. सिध् with
उद्), height, elevation; thickness, fatness, obesity;
intumescence; excelling, sublimity; the body; (अम्),
n. killing, slaughter.
उत्स्थल उत्-स्थल, अम्, n., N. of an island.

उत्स्मि उत्-स्मि (उद्-स्˚), cl. 1. A. -स्मयते,
-स्मेतुम्, to smile at, deride: Caus. P. -स्माययति,
-यितुम्, to make a fool of one.
उत्-स्मय, अस्, m. a smile.
उत्-स्मयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, smiling.

उत्स्य उत्स्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उत्स), Ved. coming
from a well or fountain (as water).

उत्स्वप्नाय उत्स्वप्नाय, nom. (fr. उद्-स्वप्न)
A. उत्स्वप्नायते, to talk in one's sleep; to dream
uneasily.

उत्-सर्पिणी; add — ‘ascending scale,’ divided into
six stages (beginning with bad-bad, and rising upwards
in the reverse order to अव-सर्पिणी, q. v., col. 2).

उत्-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the flow of life or
current of nutriment upwards (opposed to अर्वाक्-
स्रोतस्, q. v.).
